tool_args.rationale: The monotone concave pilot and sink-gradient signature are consistent with several archived mechanisms. A wider-gradient open-branch probe is needed to distinguish them before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the siphon, cooperative Hill, or barrier-modulated model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows cover a sink-gradient span of only 0.018, leaving sink dependence and branch choice poorly identified.
The pilot does not establish a coupled memory mechanism, and the open-branch probe more directly tests the observed sink-dependent ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to the mechanism discrimination.
